# Quick setup official auto-pricing shops
QS_OP_ONLY=§cOnly OP can use quick setup
QS_USAGE=§cUsage: /ss qs start [sell|buy] or /ss qs stop
QS_MODE_SELL=official sell
QS_MODE_BUY=official buy
QS_ALREADY_ACTIVE=§eAlready in quick setup. Hold an item and right-click a sign, or /ss qs stop
QS_NOT_ACTIVE=§cYou are not in quick setup mode
QS_START_SUCCESS=§aEntered {0} quick setup.\n§fHold an item and right-click a sign.\n§eType /ss qs stop to exit
QS_STOP_SUCCESS=§aExited auto-pricing shop quick setup
QS_NO_HELD_ITEM=§cHold the item you want to list before interacting with a sign
QS_NO_OFFICIAL_PRICE=§cItem §e{0} §chas no official price and cannot be used for quick setup
QS_PLACEHOLDER_PRICE=§eItem §f{0} §ehas no official price yet; temporary sell price is §c99999§e. Recycle opens after you add a buy price in official_prices.yml and run /market reload
QS_CONTINUE_HINT=§7Still in quick setup: hold an item and click another sign, or /ss qs stop
